title: Unformatted let-assert line in integration test will fail CI format gate
evidence:
let assert Ok(entry) =
    list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })
detail: gleam format --check . from server/ exits 1. CI (test.yml:102-104) runs this exact gate and will block merge.
recommended_fix: Run gleam format server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam to join lines 342-343.

detail: Function name says 'only_on_shortlisted' but the test comment correctly notes Shortlisted AND Viewed. Name is misleading.
